shell.noBrowser: No browser found to open the link.
shell.running: Reads your solar system around the clock. In the home network: this tablet's address with port {port}.
shell.saveFailed: The file could not be saved. Please try again.
shell.stoppedHint: OpenAmpere could not start several times in a row and no longer tries by itself. Open the app again and OpenAmpere makes a new attempt.

updates.confirm: Android asks before it installs the update: tap the notification "Update to version {version} ready" and then "Install".
updates.allowText: Tap here and allow OpenAmpere to install apps. Only then can it install updates.
updates.notAllowed: Android does not allow OpenAmpere to install updates yet. Tap the notification "Allow updates", switch the setting on and start the update again.
updates.noFile: There is no app file for version {version} yet. Please try again later.
updates.downloadFailed: The new version could not be downloaded. Please check the tablet's internet connection and try again later.
updates.checksumWrong: The downloaded file does not match the checksum of the release. The update was not installed, please try again later.
updates.signatureWrong: The downloaded app is not signed with the key of OpenAmpere. The update was not installed.
updates.notNewer: Version {version} is not newer than the installed app. There is nothing to install.
updates.installFailed: Android did not install the update ({reason}). Please try again later.
updates.allowNoNotifications: Android does not allow OpenAmpere to install updates yet. On the tablet, open Settings → Apps → OpenAmpere → "Install unknown apps", allow it there and start the update again.
updates.confirmNoNotifications: Android asks before it installs the update, but OpenAmpere may not show notifications. Allow them under Settings → Apps → OpenAmpere → Notifications and start the update again.
updates.reopenText: Tap here to open OpenAmpere again.
